entities.summary: Croatian Spring, a transformative movement in Croatia (1945–1991). Emerged from WWII: NDH and Ustasha Regime and Establishment of the Ustasha puppet state NDH under Axis occupation. Catalyzed Tito's Yugoslavia and Croatian Spring.
